QuestInfo.name: [Visitors] The Primacy's Mechanic, Kelly
QuestInfo.0: #bKelly#k has something to say to you. Maybe she can tell you more about #bthe Primacy#k.
QuestInfo.1: Kelly recently joined the Primacy and seems to have a problem. It sounds like she has a request for you.
QuestInfo.2: After their last defeat in battle, Kelly wanted to make new equipment so it doesn't happen again. Trouble is, she's not sure what she should try to make.
